extracted.intended_audience: NSF community, researchers, policymakers, and the general public interested in U.S. science policy
extracted.subtask_description: Summarize and apply the National Science Board's recommendations for updating NSF's Merit Review policy to better align funded research with societal benefits, national priorities, and improved review practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boost reviewer participation from a wider range of sectors and regions
rubrics_metrics.description: Boost participation and invite expert reviews from a wider range of industry, research institutions, venture capital, and regions of the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendation aims to strengthen NSF's agility and leverage perspectives and expertise from all sectors (industry, academia, government, states). Expand reviewer pools beyond traditional academic reviewers to include industry and regional expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasize societal benefits of NSF-funded research
rubrics_metrics.description: Emphasize that NSF-funded research must deliver societal benefits, including research that advances the nation's economic competitiveness and national security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure everything NSF funds — from basic research to technology translation to talent development — benefits the American people (per Vision 2030). Funded projects should be evaluated for potential to improve American lives and national priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build agency-level award portfolios for strategic alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Build NSF's award portfolio at the agency level for greater nimbleness and strategic alignment with national priorities, both current and emerging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Move beyond solely project-level decisions to consider the composition of awards across the agency to allow nimbleness and alignment with evolving national priorities; design portfolios that can be adjusted to address current and emerging S&T challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate accountability of public funds
rubrics_metrics.description: The agency must also strive for greater accountability of public funds, constructing award portfolios that show American taxpayers what they are getting for their investment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding decisions and portfolios should transparently show benefits to taxpayers and justify investments; consider portfolio-level reporting and metrics to communicate returns on public investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage verification of previously reported results
rubrics_metrics.description: Encouraging verification of previously reported results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote practices and review criteria that support replication and verification of past findings to strengthen confidence in reported results and research integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pursue bold, high-reward research
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuing more bold research with high reward potential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust review incentives and risk tolerance to allow funding of higher-risk, higher-reward projects that could lead to transformative advances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streamline, clarify, and harmonize funding strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF previously announced operational changes to its Merit Review to streamline, clarify, and harmonize agency funding strategies to achieve top scientific and national priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement operational and procedural changes (e.g., application, review, and portfolio-management processes) to clearer, more consistent funding strategies across the agency; note similarity to changes made by NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage multi-sector perspectives and expertise in review and planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen NSF's agility and its ability to leverage the perspectives and expertise of people in all sectors, including industry, academia, government and states.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate diverse sectoral perspectives into both review panels and strategic planning to better align research with practical needs and applications across sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop transformative partnerships with private sector, states, and communities
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF must develop transformative partnerships with the private sector, states and communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foster partnerships that connect NSF-funded research to implementation pathways, regional innovation ecosystems, and community needs to maximize societal impact and competition for the future.
